```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
generate_improvement_table <- function(df) {
  scenario <- c()
  imprvmnt_hedged_requests_nodelay <- c()
  imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p95 <- c()
  imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p99 <- c()
  imprvmnt_near_perfect_hedged_requests <- c()
  imprvmnt_perfect_hedged_requests <- c()
  for (i in 1:length(functions_to_plot)) {
    baseline_response                     = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "baseline")$response_time
    hedged_requests_nodelay_response      = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "hedged_requests_nodelay")$response_time
    hedged_requests_p95_response          = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "hedged_requests_p95")$response_time
    hedged_requests_p99_response          = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "hedged_requests_p99")$response_time
    near_perfect_hedged_requests_response = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "near_perfect_hedged_requests")$response_time
    perfect_hedged_requests_response      = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "perfect_hedged_requests")$response_time
  
    scenario                              <- append(scenario, paste(functions_to_plot[i], "response_time", sep=": "))
    imprvmnt_hedged_requests_nodelay      <- append(imprvmnt_hedged_requests_nodelay,      (1-sum(hedged_requests_nodelay_response)      /sum(baseline_response))*100)
    imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p95          <- append(imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p95,          (1-sum(hedged_requests_p95_response)          /sum(baseline_response))*100)
    imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p99          <- append(imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p99,          (1-sum(hedged_requests_p99_response)          /sum(baseline_response))*100)
    imprvmnt_near_perfect_hedged_requests <- append(imprvmnt_near_perfect_hedged_requests, (1-sum(near_perfect_hedged_requests_response) /sum(baseline_response))*100)
    imprvmnt_perfect_hedged_requests      <- append(imprvmnt_perfect_hedged_requests,      (1-sum(perfect_hedged_requests_response)      /sum(baseline_response))*100)
  
    baseline_response                     = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "baseline")$total_time_running_functions
    hedged_requests_nodelay_response      = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "hedged_requests_nodelay")$total_time_running_functions
    hedged_requests_p95_response          = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "hedged_requests_p95")$total_time_running_functions
    hedged_requests_p99_response          = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "hedged_requests_p99")$total_time_running_functions
    near_perfect_hedged_requests_response = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "near_perfect_hedged_requests")$total_time_running_functions
    perfect_hedged_requests_response      = filter(filter(df, func == functions_to_plot[i]), technique == "perfect_hedged_requests")$total_time_running_functions
  
    scenario                              <- append(scenario, paste(functions_to_plot[i], "total_time_running_functions", sep=": "))
    imprvmnt_hedged_requests_nodelay      <- append(imprvmnt_hedged_requests_nodelay,      (1-sum(hedged_requests_nodelay_response)      /sum(baseline_response))*100)
    imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p95          <- append(imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p95,          (1-sum(hedged_requests_p95_response)          /sum(baseline_response))*100)
    imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p99          <- append(imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p99,          (1-sum(hedged_requests_p99_response)          /sum(baseline_response))*100)
    imprvmnt_near_perfect_hedged_requests <- append(imprvmnt_near_perfect_hedged_requests, (1-sum(near_perfect_hedged_requests_response) /sum(baseline_response))*100)
    imprvmnt_perfect_hedged_requests      <- append(imprvmnt_perfect_hedged_requests,      (1-sum(perfect_hedged_requests_response)      /sum(baseline_response))*100)
  }
  rm(baseline_response)
  rm(hedged_requests_nodelay_response)
  rm(hedged_requests_p95_response)
  rm(hedged_requests_p99_response)
  rm(near_perfect_hedged_requests_response)
  rm(perfect_hedged_requests_response)

  latency_table <- data.frame(
     scenario = scenario,
     hr_nodelay = imprvmnt_hedged_requests_nodelay,
     hr_p95 = imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p95,
     hr_p99 = imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p99,
     hr_near_p = imprvmnt_near_perfect_hedged_requests,
     hr_p = imprvmnt_perfect_hedged_requests
  )
  rm(scenario)
  rm(imprvmnt_hedged_requests_nodelay)
  rm(imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p95)
  rm(imprvmnt_hedged_requests_p99)
  rm(imprvmnt_near_perfect_hedged_requests)
  rm(imprvmnt_perfect_hedged_requests)

  return(latency_table)
}

latency_table = generate_improvement_table(simple_df)

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
kable(
  filter(latency_table, !grepl("weibull", scenario)),
  format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
  booktabs = TRUE, 
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Simple Model Latency Improvement Table All but Weibull") %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "hedged request (hr)" = 3, "perfect (p)" = 2)) %>% 
      kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

kable(
  filter(latency_table, grepl("weibull", scenario)),
  format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
  booktabs = TRUE, 
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Simple Model Latency Improvement Table for Weibull") %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "hedged request (hr)" = 3, "perfect (p)" = 2)) %>% 
      kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
```
